selection: Development GZSL H, then mean S/U, then lower candidate CE. Step zero is eligible. All 30 cells are completed and selections locked before evaluation.
scope: Exploratory regional adaptation on reused 20-class CUB data. Original B/32 global features, class text, temperature and 158-attribute readout remain frozen. Only final two regional visual blocks, regional ln_post/proj, and fusion train. Tokens, region_only and pooled all receive identical regional attribute supervision; no_attribute_loss is the matched no-text baseline without regional attribute loss. Three seeds and two visual learning rates; all choices locked before final evaluation.
tokens: Three views (whole image plus two detector regions), 158 separate attribute tokens per view. Shared token MLP and single-query cross attention. Pooled control repeats the mean attribute representation 158 times per view, matching length and parameters. Region-only has zero text and confidence; constant uses training-mean per-view predicted probabilities; permuted uses a fixed incorrect text association, which could be relearned.
inference: Image only plus fixed detector, class/attribute text assets and trained weights. No image labels, true attributes, or true part locations are inference inputs. Unknown attributes are masked only during probe training and evaluation. Global attribute tokens remain available when detector regions are missing.
